brief: Warm bright restaurant simulation/management game UI suite: scene overview, build menu, orders/tasks, staff management, shop, settings.

pages.role: main view — business-scene overview, resource bar, current revenue, bottom main-function nav
build menu — buildable/upgradeable building categories & cards with cost, output, unlock condition
orders/tasks — in-progress + available orders with demand, reward, countdown, claim entry
staff/role management — staff list & attributes, hire & upgrade, post assignment
shop — currency & bundles, limited-time goods, ad-acquire entry
settings — music/sfx toggles, volume slider, quality select, notification toggle, language, restore defaults
